integrity: Analytic proof establishes the recurrence and asymptotic; finite Choi and numerical checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Fixed qubit visibility 0<lambda<1; unfiltered iteration; no claim on higher dimensions, nonunital noise, optimized filters or uniform lambda limits. Integer index asymptotics carry an O_lambda(1) rounding uncertainty; priority remains subject to independent verification against unlocated equivalent specializations.
title: A log-log boundary layer for entanglement breaking under rotated qubit dephasing
